svg.title: The stacks: Impossible-architecture line drawing
svg.desc: The stacks (2D): Elaris rides a rolling ladder through shelves that never end, drawn in one fine line with no single true perspective: shelves run into the distance, hang from the ceiling, and drop down a shaft at once. A stream of gold sand motes thickens along the aisle that leads to the calling book glowing at the far end, while the ladders up and down are the wrong branches. A book falls with its shadow showing first, and the bookmark ribbon across the top has grown three of its four lengths.
